name: game_main
note: = main(); startup pushes argc/argv/envp but they are never read. atexit(kbd/timer/vga/snd shutdown), HW init, hes_init_file_list, palette HES 299/1, language_select, init_tables, intro_play, DB alloc (2489 201x23, 2626 51x57, 713c 51x435), db_load_all, sprite banks HES 3,2,6,11,15,4,7,13,16, font_load slots, figure bank DAT_00f8, offscreen bitmaps 8e62 (320x120) etc., then main loop on cur_room DS:836c != 1000 (room_enter / game_tick / room_click / room_leave)

name: hotkey_handle
note: game key code from kbd_getkey: in office Tetris (room 1, substate 2) keys 0x22/0x23/0x3d/0x28 set DAT_7a62 (1..4) and draw arrow buttons, 0 = speed up (DAT_7a5e--), 0x1f = drop (5); key 0x2f toggles player figure variant (DS:7a14) + figure_sprites_load_all; key 0x32 reads a 7-key cheat sequence (table DS:058c) -> cheat flag DS:7a7e

name: init_tables
note: notes: load_config/init_tables. Loads HES 208 (0x1a90 bytes) and splits it with config_read into DS tables 1ce0,6145,8bbc,4ff3,6215,266e,1ce9,722a,7b22,7c62(door table),7140; loads UI text file (lang idx0: 199/253.HES) and builds 430 far char* at DS:8370; allocs 3 name buffers; zeroes 1980,1b50,7688,729a,63c5,65af,6af5; DAT_7282=30 (sec/tick)

name: config_read
note: far_memcpy(dst, cfg_buf DAT_8f90 + cfg_pos DS:11e2, n); cfg_pos += n

name: room_reload
note: notes name kept; actually = go back: pops previous room from stack DS:8a28[DAT_8e6e--] into cur_room; if leaving to a room>0: room_animate(2), music_on_leave/enter, room_free_resources, room_load, screen_transition; when returning to building (room 0): realloc building bitmaps, font_get slots 2/3, building draw (27bb:000b/0b9e), game_tick once. clock_stop/clock_start bracket

name: room_enter
note: clock_stop; push cur_room on stack DS:8a28; cur_room=room; owner DAT_7a16 = door-owner byte DS:7ca8+floor*0x7a+door; music_on_leave, room_free_resources, music_on_enter, room_load(room), screen_transition(2,1,4) (except 0x3f); room 0x3d stores entry time in DS:7a6c

name: room_load
note: Ghidra adds bogus first param (segment 0x42a5). timer_pause; switch(room-1) via jump table @1054:0e75 (65 entries) loading backgrounds/sprites per room; all cases fall into tail 1054:15fb

name: room_load_frag_1149
note: NOT A FUNCTION: Ghidra entry inside a room_load switch case (instruction actually starts at 1054:1148; sets DS:7a06=0xbd..0xbf then hes_load_unpack). Port as part of room_load

name: room_load_frag_1527
note: NOT A FUNCTION: room_load case fragment (DS:0108 = hes_load_unpack(0x9a); jmp 15fb). Port as part of room_load

name: room_load_tail
note: NOT A FUNCTION: common tail of room_load (reached by jmp from cases): timer_resume, then sparse switch on cur_room (0x13 values @1054:1619, targets at +0x26) for per-room initial drawing; Ghidra's __cdecl16far label is wrong

name: room_free_resources
note: far_free_ptr on room sprite/bitmap slots DS:8eba,8e6a,00fc,00f4,0100,0104,0108,010c,0110,0114,0118,011c,0120,0124 if non-NULL

name: room_load_background
note: hes_load_unpack0(n-50) blitted at column 0xa0 and hes_load_unpack0(n) at column 0 (y=4) into the room picture (1f51:0d14), each freed after

name: day_begin
note: daily simulation: 2bd1/3264/300f/2a62 day routines, DAT_7470++, contest_tick, day counter DS:71c4++, market refill (2a62:0ea8(0x23,0x19), 2a62:0387(5,3)), info_board_build, ai_day_plan (3b0a:3f93), resets active figures, figure_sprites_load_all

name: clock_update
note: skipped in room -5 or while clock stopped; clock_get_seconds; if > 0x707f (8h): day-end sequence (tv picture 0xdc, status text 0xb4, leave all rooms, day_end_walk_home, day_begin, ...); broadcast_hour_tick (3077:0781) -> TV picture/anim updates; prints "#02d:#02d" (DS:05b5) clock in status bar when minute changes; room-specific panel refresh on minute change (rooms 0x1f, 0xb, 2)

name: stub_21bf
note: empty function (retf), no callers

name: archive_find_selected
note: locates programme DAT_79b6 (film <1000 / series >=1000) in owner's archive (DS:6ef9 + owner*0x6c, 10 genres x 4 + series row 0x6f51); sets genre row DS:79aa and slot DS:79a8 (0/0 if none)

name: schedule_remove_hour
note: schedule_clear_programme(owner DAT_7a16, hour); redraw schedule view (340d:03a3); screen_update

name: schedule_clear_programme
note: sets schedule DS:43f7[player*0x5a + hour*2]=0 and following continuation entries (value 9999)

name: schedule_hover_editable
note: maps mouse y to hour row ((y-4)/16+1) and checks it is not in the past / currently running (hour_index, minute<=4 or <=0x36 depending on column x 0x37..0xd8 / 0xd9..0x117); returns 1 if editable

name: info_board_build
note: zeroes DS:8a40 (0x68 bytes) and fills, for floors 1..13 and door slots 0..3 of the door table (DS:7c62+floor*0x7a, owner byte +0x14 <4), a (floor,door) pair per board column (column chosen by room-type sparse table @1054:2415) -> used by info board / elevator board click handlers

name: room_leave
note: right-click/back: big if-cascade on cur_room x room_substate DS:8b84 closing sub-dialogs (19e6 close_* helpers) else room_reload; special room -5 (pause overlay) restores clock accumulator DS:728e/7290

name: day_end_walk_home
note: player_walk_to_exit; clear DAT_8e62; screen_transition(1,2,4); 1f51:07c3; hour DS:71ca=17

name: player_walk_to_exit
note: room_leave until in building, then drives human figure (DS:7b22 + p*0x1e) to floor 1 / x 0x99 then x 0x48, running game_tick until arrived

name: player_walk_to_boss
note: morning: human figure walks to door 2 on floor (player*3+2), then room_enter(3) (boss); other figures reset to their targets

name: screen_transition
c_signature: void screen_transition(int16_t dir, int16_t delay, int16_t effect)
note: 1f51:112e; if effect==4: screen_wipe_in(DAT_8e62,0,0,320,120,dir,delay). ADD SP,6

name: screen_wipe_in
c_signature: void screen_wipe_in(Bitmap *src, int16_t x, int16_t y, int16_t w, int16_t h, int16_t dir, int16_t delay)
note: animated reveal of src to screen in 8-px column steps from the edges (dir 1) or centre (else), waiting 'delay' ticks per step (ticks_get); uses temp bitmap_alloc + blit_rect + scr_blit. ADD SP,0x10

name: status_show_start
note: status_text(text_get_copy(0xf6 'Start'), 0xb4) and free

name: tv_show_current_programme
note: chooses TV picture id for channel DAT_79de at current hour: 0xdc (off air), 0xec (news minutes 0..4), programme picture (film rec +0xc or genre+0xdc, series rec +0x2f or genre+0xe6), 0xed (ad) / 0xee; -> tv_show_picture

name: tv_show_picture
note: notes called it show_fullscreen_pic; actually draws picture into TV frame (bank DAT_79a2) and blits to screen at column 1, y 0x7c; uses cached bank font_get(DS:05a0 table) for 4 ids (DS:059e) else hes_load_unpack0(pic_id); channel number overlay for 0xee; remembers last id DS:05ae

name: tv_anim_setup
note: sets up animated TV-screen objects (DS:830e.., flags DS:05b0..05b4 from film/series bitfields +6 / +0x25) for the human player's current programme; loads sprite pools via sprite_pool_load(0xb0..0xb4); sets DS:79d4=7, 79d6=2

name: savegame_names_alloc
note: 10 x far_calloc(0x29) -> DS:8b92[10] (savegame slot names)

name: savegame_names_load
note: notes: config load. hes_load_raw(209) and copies 10 x 40 bytes into DS:8b92 names

name: savegame_names_save
note: notes: config save. packs 10 x 40 bytes and hes_write(209, buf, 400) inside timer_pause/resume

name: sprite_pool_load
note: hes_load_unpack(n) copied into pool bitmap DAT_8c30 at offset DS:8c3a, spritebank_fix_pointers, pool offset += size; returns far ptr into pool (callers store DX too)

name: schedule_room_refresh
note: only in room 0x1f (programme planner): redraws panel for current substate (340d:0287 / 340d:0a56 lists / 340d:1d9a) and screen_update

name: movie_agency_reload_texts

name: language_select
note: reads HES 41 (0x29) into local 20-byte buffer (key chars), shows selection dialog (38b6:0b96), waits for key or click; sets language DS:055c (0/1) used to index language file table DS:055e+lang*16
